pairs.target: kuān tuōjià zuòchéng shí , bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de ǎi . liǎnggēn héngmù jiān liú le kōng , dǐxià lìng yǒu tiēzhe xiè guǐ zǒu de huámiàn , xiāngzǐ néng wěnwěn gē zài shàngtóu , búbì bǎ jiù cáo záochéng xīn cáo .
pairs.english: The finished wide cradle was lower than Tavi expected. There was space between its two crosspieces, with sliding surfaces beneath to follow the unloading rails. The crate could rest securely on top without chiseling old slots into new ones.
pairs.hanzi: 宽托架做成时，比塔维想的矮。两根横木间留了空，底下另有贴着卸轨走的滑面，箱子能稳稳搁在上头，不必把旧槽凿成新槽。

pairs.target: wēn xiù bǎ tā liúzài cè xiè jià , mùliào , jiēsǔn hé xiànwèi zhú chù hé guò , jīnrì xiān zǒu dìmiàn de páiyǎn , bù wǎng suǒ shàng sòng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu kept it at the side rack and checked the timber, joints and stops point by point. Today was for ground rehearsal, not sending it onto the cable.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫把它留在侧卸架，木料、接榫和限位逐处核过，今日先走地面的排演，不往索上送。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng ràng tǎ wéi lìng zuò yífù liáng kuān de yàng kuàng . liǎngtiáo mù bì kěyǐ huákāi , dìng dào xūyào de kuāndù hòu yòng pǔtōng jiá kòu suǒzhù , bān dào lìngyìtóu yì bǐ , biàn búbì měi huí yòu bǎ chǐ shēnjìn xiázhǎi de jià dǐ .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng had Tavi make a separate width gauge frame. Two wooden arms could slide apart and lock at the required width with an ordinary clasp. Carried to the other end for comparison, it saved reaching a ruler beneath the cramped rack each time.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡让塔维另做一副量宽的样框。两条木臂可以滑开，定到需要的宽度后用普通夹扣锁住，搬到另一头一比，便不必每回又把尺伸进狭窄的架底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mǎi de zhéchǐ réng shōu zài zìjǐ dài lǐ , zuò yàng kuàng de mùtiáo hé jiá kòu zé shì suǒ lǐ chū de gōngjù .
pairs.english: Tavi's bought folding ruler stayed in his own bag; the wood strips and clasp for the gauge frame were office-supplied tools.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维买的折尺仍收在自己袋里，做样框的木条和夹扣则是所里出的工具。

pairs.target: yào zhuāng de kòujiàn yǔ tā zài zhé tóng zuò guò de xiāngtóng , réng yòng ruǎn héng dàilái de nà fù xiǎo jiājù .
pairs.english: The catch to be fitted was the same as he had worked on in Zhetong, using the familiar small fixture Ruan Heng had brought.
pairs.hanzi: 要装的扣件与他在折桐做过的相同，仍用阮衡带来的那副小夹具。

pairs.target: wēn xiù jiāng zìjǐ de gōngjù xiá fàngdào yìpáng , méi jiào tā zhàozhe qiánrì kànguò de xīn jiājù shì , shuō jīnrì zhīyòng tā yǐjīng huòzhǔn zuò de zhè yíxiàng , bié jiāng liǎngzhǒng bùtóng de shǒushì hùn zài yíchù .
pairs.english: Wenxiu put her own tool case aside without asking him to try the new fixture he had seen earlier. Today he would only do this already approved task, she said; don't mix two different sets of movements.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫将自己的工具匣放到一旁，没叫他照着前日看过的新夹具试，说今日只用他已经获准做的这一项，别将两种不同的手势混在一处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , zìjǐ xiān bǎ zhuōbiān de záwù yíkāi . liǎngpiàn shúxī de tiě jiàn dōu wánzhěng , tǐjī xiāngpèi , bìhé qiǎn cáo hé luǒlù chù miàn zhúyī kànguò , zài hé qīngzǎi , zhīdiǎn hé dǎng kuài .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded and first cleared the clutter beside the table himself. Both familiar iron pieces were intact with matched whole volumes. He checked the closed shallow grooves and bare contact patches individually, then the light loads, pivots and stops.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，自己先把桌边的杂物移开。两片熟悉的铁件都完整，体积相配，闭合浅槽和裸露触面逐一看过，再核轻载、支点和挡块。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zài páng cháwán , ràng tā zìjǐ dìngwēn xiù gāizhàn zài nǎbiān sòng xiāo .
pairs.english: After checking beside him, Ruan Heng let him decide which side Wenxiu should stand on to insert the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡在旁查完，让他自己定温岫该站在哪边送销。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yàng kuàng fānguòlái , xiān ràng wēn xiù ná yìgēn mòrù kǒng de xiāo bǐ le bǐ .
pairs.english: He turned the frame over and first had Wenxiu try the approach with a pin kept outside the hole.
pairs.hanzi: 他将样框翻过来，先让温岫拿一根没入孔的销比了比。

pairs.target: tā yuán xiǎng cóng yòushǒubiān shēnjìnqù , tā què kànjiàn tā de xiùkǒu huì cā guò bǎichuí , biàn jiāng kōng de mùliào kuāng nuókāi , qǐng tā huàn dào xié qiánfāng .
pairs.english: She had planned to reach in from the right, but he saw her cuff would brush the pendulum, so he moved the empty timber basket and asked her to move diagonally in front.
pairs.hanzi: 她原想从右手边伸进去，他却看见她的袖口会擦过摆锤，便将空的木料筐挪开，请她换到斜前方。

pairs.target: tā shì zhe sòng le yìhuí , xiùkǒu hé bǎichuí zhījiān zhè cái zhēnzhèng kōng chūlái .
pairs.english: She tried the insertion once, and only then was there truly room between her cuff and the pendulum.
pairs.hanzi: 她试着送了一回，袖口和摆锤之间这才真正空出来。

pairs.target: wēn xiù tái yǎnkàn tā , wèn zhèbiān xíngbùxíng . tā méiyǒu mǎshàng shuō xíng , yòu yòng chǐ bèi bǐ guò xiāo de láilù , quèrèn bù dǎng zìjǐ chóngxīn jiēchù liǎngpiàn tiě jiàn , cái ràng tā jiāng xiāo tuìhuíqù .
pairs.english: Wenxiu looked up and asked if this side worked. He did not agree immediately, first checking the pin's approach with the back of his ruler, making sure it would not obstruct recontact with both iron pieces before asking her to withdraw the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫抬眼看他，问这边行不行。他没有马上说行，又用尺背比过销的来路，确认不挡自己重新接触两片铁件，才让她将销退回去。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yǐjīng zhàn zài néng kànjiàn liǎngcè kèxiàn de wèizhì , méiyǒu tì tā huàndiào gāng dìngxià de zhànwèi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng was already standing where he could see both sets of marks and did not change the position Tavi had just chosen.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡已经站在能看见两侧刻线的位置，没有替他换掉刚定下的站位。

pairs.target: pǔtōng dúshù jì hǎo hòu , tǎ wéi jiāng shuāngshǒu tiē dào gèzì chù miàn , zhùyìlì fàngzài liǎngpiàn wánzhěng de tǐjī shàng .
pairs.english: After recording the ordinary readings, Tavi placed a hand on each contact patch, attending to the whole volume of both pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 普通读数记好后，塔维将双手贴到各自触面，注意力放在两片完整的体积上。

pairs.target: yìbiān zài qīngzǎi xià shāoshāo ràngkāi , lìngyìbiān de fǎnxiàng biànhuà yě dào le shúxī de xiǎo fànwéi .
pairs.english: One side yielded slightly under the light load, while the opposite change on the other also reached the familiar small range.
pairs.hanzi: 一边在轻载下稍稍让开，另一边的反向变化也到了熟悉的小范围。

pairs.target: tā búzài qù dīng yàng kuàngshàng nàtiáo xīn mùwén , xiān kànqīng liǎngbiān dōu wěn , cái shuō kěyǐ .
pairs.english: He stopped staring at the new wood grain on the gauge frame and first made sure both sides were steady before giving the word.
pairs.hanzi: 他不再去盯样框上那条新木纹，先看清两边都稳，才说可以。

pairs.target: shuāngshǒu yìtóng tái kāi , jiājù réng bǎo zhe nà yìdiǎn duǎnduǎnde yúliú .
pairs.english: He lifted both hands together; the fixture retained that tiny brief residue.
pairs.hanzi: 双手一同抬开，夹具仍保着那一点短短的余留。

pairs.target: wēn xiù de xiāo zài bǎichuí dìyīshēng xiǎngqǐ qián yǐjīng sòngdào wèi , tǎ wéi lìkè chóngxīn tóngshí jiēchù liǎngchù , zhèngcháng shōuhuí jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu's pin was in place before the pendulum's first click; Tavi immediately recontacted both patches together and canceled the borrowing normally.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫的销在摆锤第一声响起前已经送到位，塔维立刻重新同时接触两处，正常收回借性。

pairs.target: liǎngcè huídào yuánlái de qīngzǎi dúshù , ruǎn héng cái jiào xièzài , zuìhòu zài hé guīwèi .
pairs.english: Both sides returned to their original light-load readings before Ruan Heng called for unloading and a final return check.
pairs.hanzi: 两侧回到原来的轻载读数，阮衡才叫卸载，最后再核归位。

pairs.target: xiāo liúxià , pǔtōng kòutóu jiāng yàng kuàng jiázhù . wēn xiù tí qǐlái huàng le yíxià , yòu yòngliáng piàn kànguò suǒdìng chù , ràng tǎ wéi ná qù yǔ xiè jià bǐ .
pairs.english: The pin remained; an ordinary clasp held the gauge frame. Wenxiu lifted and shook it, checked the lock with a gauge and told Tavi to compare it with the rack.
pairs.hanzi: 销留下，普通扣头将样框夹住。温岫提起来晃了一下，又用量片看过锁定处，让塔维拿去与卸架比。

pairs.target: tā xiān zuò zhe huǎn le piànkè , yǎnjīng nà gǔ xìxìde pí yì sàn xiàqù , cái qǐshēn bào qǐ yàng kuàng , méiyǒu zài zuò dìèrcì .
pairs.english: He first sat for a short rest until the faint fatigue in his eyes eased, then stood with the frame, without making a second attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 他先坐着缓了片刻，眼睛那股细细的疲意散下去，才起身抱起样框，没有再做第二次。

pairs.target: cóng gōngpéng dào cè xiè jià , yào jīngguò huòchǎng yíkuài shài dédào tàiyáng de kòngdì .
pairs.english: The way from the workshop to the side rack passed a sunny open patch in the freight yard.
pairs.hanzi: 从工棚到侧卸架，要经过货场一块晒得到太阳的空地。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu zhe , jiāng yàng kuàng táigāo yìdiǎn , tūrán míngbái zìjǐ fāngcái wèishénme méiyǒu jí zhe dāying . búshì pà shuōcuò yíjù , shì tā zhōngyú néng zài biérén shēnshǒu zhīqián , kànjiàn nàtiáo shǒubì dàodǐ huì cóng nǎlǐ guòqù .
pairs.english: As he walked, Tavi lifted the frame a little higher and suddenly understood why he had not rushed to agree earlier. He was not afraid of saying something wrong; he could finally see where an arm would pass before someone reached in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走着，将样框抬高一点，突然明白自己方才为什么没有急着答应。不是怕说错一句，是他终于能在别人伸手之前，看见那条手臂到底会从哪里过去。

pairs.target: dù chéng hé liǎngmíng bān gōng yǐjīng děng zhe , yìpáng fàng le chēng guò de pèizhòng bāo .
pairs.english: Du Cheng and two porters were waiting already, with weighed ballast bags set beside them.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄和两名搬工已经等着，一旁放了称过的配重包。

pairs.target: wēn xiù xiān ràng kōngxiāng zuò shàng tuōjià , shì guò qiánhòu huáyí , zài àn jìlù fēn cì fàngrù yùdìng de xiǎo zàizhòng , zhī zài dìmiàn hé kàn mùjià yǔ xiè guǐ de fǎnyìng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu first set the empty crate on the cradle and tested forward and backward sliding, then added the specified light loads in stages according to the record, checking the wooden frame and rails' response only on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫先让空箱坐上托架，试过前后滑移，再按记录分次放入预定的小载重，只在地面核看木架与卸轨的反应。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná yàng kuàng bǐ liǎngtóu de kuāndù , lìng yǒurén fú xiāng , tā méi shēnshǒu qù tì rènhérén tuōzhù yīngdāng bèi kànqīng de qīngxié .
pairs.english: Tavi compared both ends' widths with the frame while someone else steadied the crate. He did not reach in to conceal a tilt they needed to observe by supporting it for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿样框比两头的宽度，另有人扶箱，他没伸手去替任何人托住应当被看清的倾斜。

pairs.target: páiyǎn dào wǔhòu cái tíng . liǎngbiān huá miànshàng duō le xīn de mó hén , wēn xiù quān chū yíchù xūpáo píng de máobiān , jiào mùgōng chǔlǐ , chǔlǐ hòu zài shì yìhuí , bùnéng ná yóu suíbiàn mǒ guòqù .
pairs.english: Rehearsal lasted into the afternoon. New wear marks appeared on both sliding surfaces. Wenxiu circled a rough edge needing planing and had the carpenter fix it before retesting, rather than simply smearing oil over it.
pairs.hanzi: 排演到午后才停。两边滑面上多了新的磨痕，温岫圈出一处须刨平的毛边，叫木工处理，处理后再试一回，不能拿油随便抹过去。

pairs.target: dù chéng zé bǎ tuī jià yǔ jiē xiāng de rén huàn guò wèizhì , wèn nǎbiān néng kànjiàn duìfāng de shǒushì .
pairs.english: Du Cheng switched the cradle pusher and crate receiver's positions, asking which side let them see each other's signals.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄则把推架与接箱的人换过位置，问哪边能看见对方的手势。

pairs.target: lín sàn qián , zhuǎnyùn huì sònglái cìrì shìyùn de yònggōng tiáo .
pairs.english: Before they dispersed, the transfer association sent the staffing slip for tomorrow's trial run.
pairs.hanzi: 临散前，转运会送来次日试运的用工条。

pairs.target: huōyá bān gōng hé xià róng gè yǒu yíduàn shìyòng gōngshí , àn shìxiān shuō qīng de bānfèi fù , bù cóng tāmen yuán gāi lǐng de chāizhuāng qián lǐ dǐ . liǎng rén dōu kànguò shùmù , cái dāying míngzǎo lái . yǐhòu zěnme ānpái , réng bú zài zhè zhāng tiáo shàng .
pairs.english: The gap-toothed porter and Xiarong each had trial hours paid at the agreed shift rate, without deductions from unpacking pay already owed. Both checked the amounts before agreeing to come tomorrow morning. Future arrangements were still absent from this slip.
pairs.hanzi: 豁牙搬工和夏绒各有一段试用工时，按事先说清的班费付，不从他们原该领的拆装钱里抵。两人都看过数目，才答应明早来。以后怎么安排，仍不在这张条上。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng chǔlǐ hòu de páiyǎn jìlù jiāogěi wēn xiù , yuē hǎo cìrì yóu zhǎng lún yǔ jiēhuò liǎngtóu zài hé fēng kuàng , xiān kōngzǎi , guò le cái kàn nà yífèn zhǐdìng de qīngzǎi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng gave Wenxiu the corrected rehearsal record, agreeing that tomorrow the wheel and receiving operators would check wind conditions again: empty first, then only if that passed, the specified light load.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将处理后的排演记录交给温岫，约好次日由掌轮与接货两头再核风况，先空载，过了才看那一份指定的轻载。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ gōngjù shōuhuí gōngpéng , yàng kuàng kào zài zìjǐ dèng biān .
pairs.english: Tavi put the tools back in the workshop, resting the gauge frame beside his stool.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把工具收回工棚，样框靠在自己凳边。

pairs.target: tā yòng zhǐtou zài kuàng yán qīngqiāo liǎngxià , jìng jiēshàng zuówǎn nàduàn diàozi de kāitóu . wēn xiù jīngguò , wèn zhè shì xīntiān de liángjù xiǎngshēng me . tā shuō búshì , liánmáng jiāng shǒu fàngxià , tā què yǐ qiāo le dìsān xià , jiào tā bié bǎ xià yì pāi yòu lòudiào .
pairs.english: He tapped the frame edge lightly twice and unexpectedly found the opening of last night's tune. Passing by, Wenxiu asked if that was a new gauge sound. He said no and hastily lowered his hand, but she had tapped the third beat already, telling him not to miss the next one again.
pairs.hanzi: 他用指头在框沿轻敲两下，竟接上昨晚那段调子的开头。温岫经过，问这是新添的量具响声么。他说不是，连忙将手放下，她却已敲了第三下，叫他别把下一拍又漏掉。
